answer_1.quote: In this work, we consider the task of automatic text summarization, i.e., the task of generating a concise summary of a given document that preserves its most salient information .

answer_2.quote: ROUGE: ROUGE (Recall-Oriented Understudy for Gisting Evaluation) is a common metric for evaluating text generation tasks including abstractive summarization.
